title: Bond_Bridge
lead_summary:
Bond Bridge is a route that connects Berry Forest to Kin Island.
One of the Spaceship component can be found on top of the waterfall, by two agents.
After rescuing Jasmine's Nephew and his friends in the Berry Forest, she will accept the player's challenge and battle on the bridge.  
After beating Jasmine, she will give the player a Lvl. 30 Mareanie, which can be used to scare away the Corsola on Brine Road, leading to the Water Labyrinth, Resort Gorgeous, and Chrono Island.
Note: This Mareanie will not scare away the Corsola on Mt. Ember, that requires the Mareanie Doll found on Kin Island.
